# The Core Keeper server's command line as the Plan builds it (spec 5.8).
# Paths are relative to the instance's folder, games/corekeeper.

## A new world, mode hard, seed "Nice World"
exe: <instance>/server/CoreKeeperServer
dir: <instance>/server
  -batchmode
  -logfile
  <instance>/logs/corekeeper-2026-11-26_21-35-10.log
  -datapath
  <instance>/saves/Crow's Cave
  -world
  0
  -worldname
  Core Keeper server
  -maxplayers
  8
  -gameid
  Ab3dEfGh9JkLmNpQrStUvWz12345
  -worldmode
  Hard
  -worldseed
  Nice World
output: LogArg
readyWait: 10m0s
record server: Core Keeper server

## The same world later, renamed server, 4 players
exe: <instance>/server/CoreKeeperServer
dir: <instance>/server
  -batchmode
  -logfile
  <instance>/logs/corekeeper-2026-11-26_21-35-10.log
  -datapath
  <instance>/saves/Crow's Cave
  -world
  0
  -worldname
  Friends' Cave
  -maxplayers
  4
  -gameid
  Ab3dEfGh9JkLmNpQrStUvWz12345
output: LogArg
readyWait: 5m0s
record server: Friends' Cave

## A new world with the defaults (no seed: the server picks one)
exe: <instance>/server/CoreKeeperServer
dir: <instance>/server
  -batchmode
  -logfile
  <instance>/logs/corekeeper-2026-11-26_21-35-10.log
  -datapath
  <instance>/saves/Second
  -world
  0
  -worldname
  Core Keeper server
  -maxplayers
  8
  -gameid
  Ab3dEfGh9JkLmNpQrStUvWz12345
  -worldmode
  Normal
output: LogArg
readyWait: 10m0s
record server: Core Keeper server
